snippet.title: Mother Zina - Official Teaser Trailer
snippet.description: Check out the Mother Zina teaser trailer for this upcoming story-driven, first-person psychological thriller. You’re a journalist who came to Russia for a report. After renting an apartment from Zinaida Petrovna, you quickly realize she’s hiding something - and this place isn’t meant for random tenants. To get out, you’ll have to dig into her past - and keep your sanity. Mother Zina will be available on PC via Steam.
